text:
Priya Desai: FYI candidate Mateo Ruiz (Infra SWE) is JST-based and needs the device same-week. He
sked for expedited overnight shipment to Tokyo office pickup.
Sam (Recruiter): He signed LOA and NDA. Prefers interviews between 10:00-14:00 JST only. Also noted he can't take calls before 09:00 JST.
Owen: Inventory low for encrypted loaners this week. Do we have a spare we can overnight?
Tess: We have one spare but overnight requires courier+insurance. PeopleOps policy requires BG clear and LOA before release.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Expedited shipments need manager approval + asset insurance. Submit via https://redwood/internal/loaner-request with "EXPEDITE" in subject.
Sam (Recruiter): Candidate BG cleared yesterday. LOA & NDA uploaded. I'll request courier hold at Tokyo office for pickup.
Priya Desai: Scheduling note: JST (UTC+9) vs PDT (UTC-8) = 17h difference. 10:00 JST = 17:00 PDT (previous day). Panel can do late afternoon PDT to meet candidate window. Options: Mon 2026-09-14 17:00 PDT / Tue 10:00 JST or Wed 16:00 PDT / Thu 09:00 JST.
Owen: I can do Mon 17:00 PDT. Rico?
Rico: Mon works. Tess?
Tess: I'll be available Mon but need the meeting to end by 14:00 JST. That means start no later than 12:00 JST. Mon 10:00 JST is better.
Priya Desai: OK final: Mon 2026-09-14 17:00 PDT / Tue 2026-09-15 10:00 JST (panel confirmed). Sam please add a note offering a 2-hr flex pay for off-hours panel if any interviewer joins before 08:00 their local time.
Sam (Recruiter): Added flex pay note and fallback: recorded pair-coding for one interviewer if conflicts. Also added troubleshooting checklist: `-- confirm VPN 20m prior -- test meeting link 10m prior -- ops contact: tokyo-ops@redwood.com`
Tess: Please ensure courier hold name: "Redwood Ops - Mateo Ruiz" and pickup ID.
PeopleOps Bot: Shipment label created: TRACKJP123456789. Insurance added. Estimated arrival 2026-09-13 09:30 JST.
Owen: Created LOANER-2026-922 with expedite flag. Marking asset RW-2026-881 as reserved.
Sam (Recruiter): Invite sent to candidate and panel. Candidate replied: "Thanks — pickup noted, see you at 10:00 JST." :smile: 
Priya Desai: Great. After interview we'll collect device feedback and log any candidate experience notes. Thanks team.
